source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"No other intervention at all, since positioning alone is generally considered sufficient on its own for this purpose","B":"Percussion or vibration, to further help loosen secretions for improved clearance from the targeted lung segment","C":"Complete restriction of the client's ability to cough throughout the entire postural drainage session","D":"A body position that carries fairly little established relationship to any specific lung segment being targeted"}}
source_row.rationale: Postural drainage uses gravity, with positioning specific to the targeted lung segment, and is often combined with percussion or vibration to further help loosen secretions for improved clearance, an established combined approach in pulmonary hygiene for clients with excessive secretions.
source_row.source_name: AARC — Postural Drainage Clinical Practice Guideline
